name: medicine ball chest push single response
description: A kneeling medicine-ball chest pass performed one powerful throw at a time, with a full reset between reps.
instructions: Kneel upright facing a partner or a sturdy rebound wall and hold a medicine ball at chest height.
Brace your trunk and push the ball forward forcefully with both hands.
Catch or retrieve the ball and bring it back to your chest.
Pause to reset your posture before the next throw.
